title: Start with the graduate arrival checklists
description: Use Graduate Division’s checklists to organize questions before arrival and during your first weeks.

title: Contact the International Center
description: Find official new-student information and the right office for immigration questions.

title: Explore graduate and family housing
description: Check the university’s current housing options, application process and eligibility details directly.

title: Plan your trip to campus
description: Find parking information, campus maps and transportation options. Check current rules before traveling.

title: Find your building
description: Use the campus map service to plan the walk from parking or transit to your destination.

title: Review new-student health information
description: Go to the Student Health Center for current admission health information and student health services.

title: Find counseling and well-being resources
description: The Counseling Center lists resources for graduate students and routes to its services.

title: Get help with basic needs
description: Find the Basic Needs Center’s food resources, housing support and consultation information.

title: Find graduate workshops and writing support
description: Explore the Graduate & Postdoctoral Scholar Resource Center’s workshops and links to writing support.

title: Connect with graduate student government
description: Learn about Associated Graduate Students, its representation and opportunities to take part.

title: Find library support for your research
description: Use the Libraries’ graduate guide to find research services, tools and library workshops.

title: Work on your graduate writing
description: The Graduate Writing Hub lists writing consultations and programs for graduate students and postdoctoral scholars.

title: Explore your next career step
description: Find graduate career advising, job-search resources and events through the Division of Career Pathways.

title: Arrange disability accommodations
description: Find registration information, accommodation services and ways to report an access barrier through the Disability Services Center.

title: Check the campus shuttle routes
description: Use Anteater Express for route maps, current schedules and service updates before your trip.

title: Find recreation classes and facilities
description: Check Campus Recreation for ARC hours, activity programs and current membership information.

title: Set up your campus technology
description: OIT’s graduate guide links to UCInetID, email, internet access and technical support information.

title: Develop your teaching practice
description: Explore DTEI’s teaching workshops and training opportunities for graduate students and postdoctoral scholars.
source: UCI Division of Teaching Excellence and Innovation
